name: neo-nexus
description: Connect Codex engineering work with Neo-Nexus projects and client requests.

interface.shortDescription: Work on Neo-Nexus client requests from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Gives engineers permission-checked project context, client tasks and issues, and Neo-Nexus tracking health inside Codex. It reuses the authenticated local Neo-Nexus CLI and never sends prompts or source files.
defaultPrompt: Show the Neo-Nexus context for this project.
What client requests should I work on?
Check Neo-Nexus tracking health for this repo.
